scenes.script:
Rahul says: Kititari varsha expensive English classes var waste kele, tari pan interviews madhye freeze vhaycho. Mag mala bhetla Supernova AI.
Rahul says: Ata mi Miss Nova sobat privately speaking practice karto. Ti mazyasathi ek custom plan banavte ani mazyatlya mistakes var kadhich judge karat nahi!
scenes.on_screen_text:
Top: English classes var paise waste kele tari interviews madhye freeze houn radtana mi.

Bottom: Supernova AI var Miss Nova sobat privately speaking practice kelya nantar cha mi.

Used warm, peer-level colloquial Marathi ('vhaycho', 'karto', 'mazyasathi') avoiding any formal or newspaperish vocabulary (T3, T4). Romanized the text using standard WhatsApp-style spelling without diacritics (T10).
